description: Generate 3D meshes using ArtCraft's OmniGen Mesh API. Supports Hunyuan 3D v2/v3/v3.1 (Pro, Rapid, Part, Topology), Tripo3D H3.1, Meshy 6 and Rodin 2.5 Fast, with multi-view camera inputs.
name: artcraft_generate_3d_object

back_image_media_token.description: Back camera view for multi-view input

enable_texture.description: Generate textures (Tripo3D can skip texturing for a cheaper run)

front_image_media_token.description: Front camera view for multi-view input

geometry_quality.description: Geometry quality (detailed costs extra on Tripo3D)

input_mesh_media_file_token.description: Input mesh for retopology (Topology) or semantic part splitting (Part)

left_image_media_token.description: Left camera view for multi-view input

right_image_media_token.description: Right camera view for multi-view input

texture_quality.description: Texture quality (detailed costs extra on Tripo3D)
